svg.title: Every Thread at Every Level
svg.desc: Sketch in perspective: an open-sided building of three storeys, its floors marked at the side, from the ground up, with a square, a triangle, and a diamond. A rope, hatched, hangs from the roof down the front of the building, passing through a ring at the edge of every floor. Beside the building, a mannequin holds the rope's lower end. The building is the site, and its three floors are the levels of rules, in the site's column marks: the square is guides (operational), the triangle is governance (collective-choice and constitutional), and the diamond is theory (metaconstitutional). The rope is one topic thread. Threaded through every floor, it is the solution, the focus: write about each thread at every level. The figure holding it is a contributor. The metaphor: a thread that ties a building's floors together, so moving between levels is a matter of following the rope.
